purpose: Harness-native Production Evals pack for Nexxus Connect v2.2. Fully wired to Ghost entry/exit gates, enforcer checklist, cross-sign, watchdog, and pre-commit hook.
criticalRules: Playwright is the witness, not the judge.
Run exactly one sprint at a time.
Run exactly one flow at a time inside a sprint.
No acceptance without evidence and commentary.
Ghost Entry Gate APPROVED required before execution.
Ghost Exit Gate CLEARED required before next sprint.
Enforcer-checklist.txt with RESULT: APPROVED required per sprint.
Cross-sign.md with different reviewing role required per sprint.
Sprint must be registered in sprints.json before work begins.
All commits require COMMIT_ROLE and COMMIT_SPRINT env vars.
